claim.claim-text: 2. The extension ladder of claim 1, wherein the right fly flange and the left fly flange extend from the fly web towards the left fly rail such that the fly web is between the base web and the right and left fly flanges, and the fly rungs being secured to the fly web.
3. The extension ladder of claim 1, wherein the first and second stems are positioned to space the right and left fly flanges from the right and left base flanges respectively.
4. The extension ladder of claim 1, wherein the fly rungs are secured to the fly web at a central portion of the fly web.
5. The extension ladder of claim 1, wherein the right fly rail has a C-shaped cross-section defined by the fly web, the right fly flange, and the left fly flange.
6. The extension ladder of claim 1, wherein each rung of the base rungs includes flattened ends secured to the right base rail and left base rail.

7. The extension ladder of claim 1, wherein the base section further includes a lock rung having a flat end face extending substantially perpendicular to the right base flange, further comprising a J-lock mounted to the lock rung and extending from the flat end face of the lock rung.

8. The extension ladder of claim 1, wherein the base section further includes a lock rung having a flat end face extending substantially perpendicular to the right base flange, and each rung the base rungs includes flattened ends secured to the right base rail and left base rail.
9. The extension ladder of claim 1, wherein the first and second stems each extend along a longitudinal length of the right base rail.

10. The extension ladder of claim 1, wherein the locking mechanism includes a J-lock having a pin portion, wherein each of the fly rungs define locking holes at the fly web to receive the pin portion of the J-lock.

11. The extension ladder of claim 1, wherein the first stem is positioned on an intermediate portion of the right base flange and the second stem is positioned on an intermediate portion of the left base flange.

12. The extension ladder of claim 1, wherein the locking mechanism includes a swing lock mounted to the right fly rail and configured to secure a rung of the fly rungs and a rung of the base rungs together to inhibit the fly section from moving relative to the base section.

13. The extension ladder of claim 1, wherein the base rungs are secured to the right base flange of the right base rail by fasteners, wherein the first stem spaces the right fly rail from the fasteners.

14. The extension ladder of claim 1, wherein the right base flange includes a third stem extending inwardly toward the left base flange to guide the right fly rail as the fly section is moved relative to the base section.

15. The extension ladder of claim 1, wherein the left base rail includes a second base web and a second right base flange and a second left base flange extending from the second base web, the left fly rail positioned between the second right base flange and the second left base flange of the left base rail such that the left base rail guides movement of the fly section relative to the base section.
